# anime.js (vendored)

Anime.js v4.5.0 by Julian Garnier, MIT (see `LICENSE.md`). Copied from `dist/modules` (ESM and type
declarations) of [dark3panther/anime](https://github.com/dark3panther/anime), commit `01b81be`.
Import it as `import { animate, createTimeline, stagger } from '../vendor/animejs'`; the bundler keeps
only what the app uses. Unmodified.
